description: Exclusive to Reflectors. The only authority that follows a full 28-day moon cycle.
decision_style: Wait the full lunar cycle (28 days) before making major decisions. During this time, speak with different trusted people and sample different environments. By the end of the cycle, clarity emerges.
time_to_decide: 28 days for major decisions. Use the time to sample perspectives, not to analyse repeatedly.
career_application: Never accept a major career offer immediately. Request a reasonable time to consider. Use the 28 days to sit with the opportunity, visit environments, and speak with trusted advisors. Clarity will emerge naturally.
common_mistake: Rushing major decisions, or making them in a single conversation or environment.
